info.name: IndustriaLink API (local)
info.description:
Run folder "0. Start here" first: it logs in and saves the tokens.
Every request checks its status code (see the Test Results tab).
Reset demo data any time with: npm run db:seed

item.name: 0. Start here – log in
item.description: Run these first. Each login saves its token, so the other folders just work.

item.name: Sign in with Google: request is checked (422)
1. Account and settings
item.description: Uses the worker login from folder 0.

item.name: Register this phone for push notifications
Turn push off for this phone
Log in with the new password
Help form as a logged-in worker
Help form as a guest (no login)
Sign up: worker who will delete the account
2. Worker
item.description: Uses the worker login from folder 0.

formdata.description: Click "Select Files" and choose a PDF, JPG or PNG (max 5 MB). A sample is in industrialink-backend/postman/sample-resume.pdf

item.name: Open a job (no HR phone inside)
One company and its open jobs
3. Employer
item.description: Uses the Konark HR login (approved company) from folder 0.

item.name: Upload GST certificate (choose a PDF file)

formdata.description: Click "Select Files" and choose a PDF, JPG or PNG (max 5 MB). A sample is in industrialink-backend/postman/sample-resume.pdf

item.name: 4. Admin
item.description: Uses the admin login from folder 0. Changes demo data: run "npm run db:seed" to reset.

item.name: Remove a job (the one posted in folder 3)
Block the new worker from folder 1
5. Public (no login)
item.description: No token needed: shared job links and the landing site.

item.name: One job without login (no HR phone)
Job feed for the landing site
6. Applying and hiring
item.description: The full hiring flow: HR posts a job, the worker applies, HR shortlists, invites to an interview, sends an offer, the worker accepts, HR marks them hired. Uses the worker and Konark HR logins from folder 0.

item.name: HR posts a job for this test
Worker now sees the HR phone
HR: interview in the past is refused (422)
7. Chat
item.description: Worker and HR chat on the application from folder 6 (the worker is hired, so the chat is open). Admins cannot read chats.
